expected_value_creation: QIF v0.2.1 packages become more executable and auditable because raw answers, questions, derivations, applicability, governance outcomes, and confidence policies are explicit and verifier-checkable.
beneficiary: Organizations and AI/human reviewers applying QIF to domain-general evaluation targets
supporting_evidence: User acceptance criteria require npm test to verify end-to-end packages with raw answers, extraction, derivations, executable rules, governance triggers, and confidence reproducibility.
Existing v0.2 hardening already has schemas, examples, verifier logic, and AOF evidence that can be refined rather than redesigned.
success_criteria: npm test passes and runtime verifier checks the new v0.2.1 traceability rules.
Docs and examples show derivation records separate from Quality Intents and confidence reproduced through policies rather than verdict average alone.
